title: Auto Loans: Late Charge and Returned Payment Fee Schedule
content:
Late charges on Auto Loans follow the borrower's state of residence, while the returned payment fee and the courtesy waiver allowances are set per product. This schedule gathers those amounts and counts for all six products.

## Late charge terms by state (identical on every product)

| Borrower's state of residence | Grace period (calendar days after the due date) | Late charge rate (percent of the installment) | Largest late charge per installment (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| North Carolina (NC) | 15 | 4.00 | 25.00 |
| South Carolina (SC) | 10 | 5.00 | 18.50 |
| Virginia (VA) | 7 | 5.00 | 30.00 |

## Figures by product

| Loan product | Grace days NC / SC / VA | Rate NC / SC / VA (percent) | Largest charge NC / SC / VA (USD) | Returned payment fee (USD) | Courtesy late charge waivers per rolling 365 days | Consecutive on-time installments a courtesy waiver needs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 15 / 10 / 7 | 4.00 / 5.00 / 5.00 | 25.00 / 18.50 / 30.00 | 25.00 | 1 | 6 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 15 / 10 / 7 | 4.00 / 5.00 / 5.00 | 25.00 / 18.50 / 30.00 | 25.00 | 1 | 6 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 15 / 10 / 7 | 4.00 / 5.00 / 5.00 | 25.00 / 18.50 / 30.00 | 25.00 | 1 | 6 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 15 / 10 / 7 | 4.00 / 5.00 / 5.00 | 25.00 / 18.50 / 30.00 | 25.00 | 1 | 6 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 15 / 10 / 7 | 4.00 / 5.00 / 5.00 | 25.00 / 18.50 / 30.00 | 25.00 | 1 | 6 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 15 / 10 / 7 | 4.00 / 5.00 / 5.00 | 25.00 / 18.50 / 30.00 | 25.00 | 2 | 6 |

## Meaning of each figure

- **Grace period**: the number of calendar days following an installment's due date that pass before a late charge can apply.
- **Late charge rate**: the charge is expressed as this percentage of the installment amount.
- **Largest late charge per installment**: no single installment's late charge may exceed this dollar figure.
- **Returned payment fee**: the flat charge made when a payment comes back unpaid.
- **Courtesy late charge waivers**: how many courtesy waivers of a late charge one customer may receive within any rolling 365-day span.
- **Consecutive on-time installments**: how long an unbroken run of on-time installments, immediately ahead of the late one, a courtesy waiver calls for.

## Quick answers

**Which state has the shortest grace period?** Virginia, at 7 days.

**Where does the dollar limit bite hardest?** South Carolina, whose limit of 18.50 dollars is the lowest of the three states.

**Does any product allow more courtesy waivers?** The Green Vehicle Loan allows two in a rolling 365 days; every other product allows one.
